title: Transactional Staging Manager
purpose: Defines same-filesystem isolated staging, validation gating, diagnostic preservation, and atomic destination promotion.

normative_requirements.text: The transactional staging manager shall create an isolated staging workspace on the destination filesystem, provide operations to populate it, and promote the complete staged directory to the absent or empty destination with one atomic same-filesystem operation.

Incomplete generation, local Git establishment, or validation shall leave the destination unmodified and preserve staging for diagnostics; promotion shall occur only after every required staged check succeeds.
